name: Ballard Sheet Metal Works Inc.

about:
Ballard Sheet Metal Works Inc. has operated from Seattle, Washington since 1907. The family-owned business began over a century ago and remains under family ownership today.

The shop provides custom metal fabrication, welding, field measuring, and installation services across the Greater Puget Sound area. Its capabilities include shearing (24 gauge to 3/8″ steel, up to 10 ft wide), forming, and welding of galvanized, hot-rolled, cold-rolled, and stainless steels, aluminum, copper, zinc, Cor-Ten, brass, and diamond plate. Products range from flashing, backsplashes, and corner guards to countertops with integrated sinks, custom hoods, fireplace surrounds, railings, stairs, awnings, and marine components such as fire dampers, HVAC ducting, and tanks.

The company serves residential homeowners, local contractors, and architects, with a notable portfolio in marine and architectural metalwork. Customers include individuals seeking custom countertops or fireplace surrounds, as well as commercial clients needing HVAC components and tank fabrication.

Ballard emphasizes its team’s experience and certified welders as differentiators, promoting in-house fabrication and installation to maintain tight tolerances and reduce seams. The firm highlights its ability to handle projects of any size while delivering craftsmanship that has sustained its reputation for more than 115 years.
